protocol.method: 24 paired AB/BA rounds, three native updates each, warm pools, fixed synthetic dense targets and identical initial state restored outside each timed call. No other experiment job runs concurrently.

protocol.interpretation: Ratios above1 favor B. Bootstrap intervals describe repeated timing observations on this host, not population/hardware uncertainty. BF16 panel tests compare one arithmetic contract with panels disabled/enabled.
